verdict.rationale: Durable long-running execution is a fair question for a workflow automation platform like Make, so the axis applies. The pack never documents runs that pause for days or keep their state through worker or platform restarts. Data stores that persist data between runs and webhook queues processed on a schedule are only adjacent building blocks or workarounds, not durable workflow execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run long-lived workflows that wait for days and survive worker or platform restarts without losing state
